name: SWCC Corporation
summary: SWCC Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of energy, infrastructure, and communication components in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Energy & Infrastructure Business and Telecommunications & Components Business segments.
